title: "Project direction"

The current documentation work connects complete **capacitance** and
**resonance/EPR** examples to the public component notebooks, then introduces
model changes and advanced execution/analysis. These teaching improvements do
not add solver families or redefine the physical outputs.

Palace Driven and Magnetostatic remain future work. Meep remains outside
SCGSim's scope. Use the [support table](backend-support.qmd) for implemented
calculations; use the [maintainer entry](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/scgsim/blob/develop/MAINTAINING.md)
for repository and release work.
